data.long_meaning: The name Bartomeu is derived from the Aramaic name Bar-Tomas, which means 'son of Thomas'. In the New Testament, Bartomeu is mentioned as one of the twelve apostles, also known as Nathanael or Nathaniel. The name Bartomeu carries the meaning “Son of Thomas” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bartomeu usually hope their child will grow to embody son of thomas and live with faith, good character and purpose.
